summary: Frontend-only testing of new drag-to-fill + auto-reflow behavior on StudyLocus dashboard grid. Logged in as admin, verified drag-to-fill grows dropped card to fill contiguous empty columns, verified vertical auto-compaction on release, verified layout persistence across reload via PUT /api/settings, and ran regressions on resize/collapse/delete buttons. All core behaviors passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js onLayoutChange re-merges hidden cards on every layout tick and calls persistLayout debounced — fine, but note fillRow mutates x/w even for tiny position adjustments where dragRef was set; because dragRef is cleared inside onLayoutChange, this only fires once per drag which is correct. Verified.

Card testids are generated from card title kebab-case; the Welcome card's testid becomes 'card-welcome!' (retains '!' from title 'Welcome!'). Consider slugifying to strip punctuation for cleaner testids (does not block current feature).

fillRow only expands within contiguous free columns at the row band of the dropped card; when a card is dropped into an empty row that has no other cards vertically overlapping, it will expand to full 12 cols. This is intended behavior per spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Drag-to-fill verified: Quote card dragged into an empty left/middle area of its row grew from width 432 -> 882 (fills contiguous free cols). Vertical compaction works (deleting Welcome or moving cards compacts remaining cards upward with no huge gaps). Persistence verified: layouts match exactly before and after reload. Resize btn cycles 4->8->12->4 cols correctly (432 -> 882). Collapse btn shrinks h to 2 rows (414 -> 78). Card testids retain punctuation from titles (Welcome! -> card-welcome!) — remember when writing selectors. Drag must be driven with page.mouse.down on .drag-handle inside card header, multiple mouse.move steps, then mouse.up.
rca of the issue: No issues found — feature works as specified.
